scientific_integrity: Exact exhaustive finite face-poset enumeration with sequential element matching, verified source code included. Established acyclicity and discrete Morse theorems give the homotopy conclusion; no finite-to-infinite inference.
scientific_limitations: Finite k=4..8 only; k>=9 and other cycle lengths unresolved by this argument. Existing homology for k=4,n=15 predates the homotopy conclusion. Equivalent unindexed results possible; no independent audit performed.
title: Five consecutive squared-cycle total-cut complexes are seven-spheres
